notes: A speedrun with a finish line and a run timer is competing on speed across a finite course, which is Racing rather than an obby taken at the player's own pace, and the Obstacle Race preset exists for exactly this high-walkspeed obstacle-course format; Obby & Platformer is named second because every hazard in the three levels is an obby block, and its options are what express them. Kept the preset's route-point-to-point shape because the author confirmed one continuous linear course flowing from the neon highway through the factory to the space station, so the three levels are sections of a single map and this stays P6 with no separate-map split. Added the obstacle rows the prompt states outright — lasers and gaps to jump, moving grid walls and rotating rollers and swinging pendulums, laser gates and platforms that vanish a second after touch — plus coin pickups and the booster pads as movement buffs. The shop was left out of the layout deliberately: the author asked for a UI menu button for trail effects, not a shop building, so there is no geometry to place, and the glowing green checkpoint pads at each section start double as the run's start marker.
